as_told.title: Beings will not let humanity go to nuclear war

plain: A man named Richard Barth, who says he was a guard at nuclear missile sites, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about beings he says he met in September 1964 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California. He says what they got across to him was that they would not let the world go to nuclear war, and that they needed to stop these missiles from launching. Later in the same interview he says his sense was that they would leave humanity alone unless we screwed up. He does not describe it as spoken words, more as something communicated to him. Richard is the only teller, telling it twice in one conversation, and it belongs to the same night as his story of being taken by them. If true, it would mean outside beings are watching over our nuclear weapons.
